research_question: Among the 15 candidate channel genes, which are represented in the GSE157504 raw feature matrix, what fraction of annotated cells has raw UMI count >0 by clock-neuron group/cluster/condition/timepoint, and which genes are listed in the authors' high-confidence rhythmic-transcript supplement?
hypothesis: Exploratory expectation only: candidate transcript detection and author-reported rhythm calls differ by clock-neuron group and LD/DD condition; this task does not test a biological hypothesis inferentially.
alternative_hypotheses: A zero UMI count can reflect single-cell dropout rather than true absence.
A gene not represented by an exact feature symbol may be unevaluable because of annotation/symbol mapping, not biological absence.
A transcript absent from the authors' high-confidence cycling list may fail their cutoffs or have insufficient power; it is not thereby proven arrhythmic.
The LN_ITP cluster contains more than one anatomical clock-neuron class and cannot be treated as pure s-LNv or LNd evidence.
preparation: Published single-cell RNA-seq count matrices for circadian neurons and the paper's author-processed high-confidence cycling-transcript supplement.
cell_type: The provided annotation covers 2,615 cells in 17 selected high-confidence clusters; broad groups include s-LNv, l-LNv, LNd, DN, and an explicitly ambiguous LN_ITP group.
experimental_unit: Single-cell count column nested within collection replicate/experiment; not an independent fly-level experimental unit for inference.
primary_readout: Descriptive fraction of uniquely matched annotated cells with raw UMI count >0 per candidate, group/cluster/condition/timepoint/replicate.
secondary_readouts: Exact candidate feature presence in the raw matrix.
Author-reported high-confidence rhythmic transcript rows by cluster and LD/DD condition, extracted without refitting the rhythm model.
Barcode join coverage and annotation time-grid coverage.
time_system: Report LD as ZT and DD as CT; the DD annotation token ztNN is condition-aware normalized to raw CTNN.
required_metadata: Cell barcode, condition, time, collection replicate, and author cluster label.
Exact raw feature symbol and raw count value.
Source experiment/fly-level identity and pool size where available; these are not fully established by the provided files.
analysis_plan: Hash-check inputs; join author annotations to all raw compressed count matrices using a documented leading-X cleanup and DD-only zt-to-CT barcode alias; summarize raw count detection without normalization or inferential tests; separately extract the authors' high-confidence rhythm rows from the eLife supplement; record all outputs and commands in the public-data manifest; replay in an isolated mirror and compare output hashes.
decision_gate: Interpret the raw-count output only if all annotation barcodes match exactly once and the replicate/timepoint annotation grid is complete. Treat absent exact features as unevaluable. Treat absence from the author high-confidence list as 'not listed under author criteria,' never as proof of no expression or arrhythmicity. No causal, current, voltage, or behavior claim is permitted from these transcript data.
acceptance_tests: Synthetic positive/negative extraction tests pass for the published-table workflow, including hash mismatch, duplicate candidates, non-finite values, output path safety, and evidence-boundary wording.
Synthetic raw-tar integration tests pass for leading-X stripping, DD-only zt-to-CT join, group mapping, absent-feature semantics, and incomplete-join nonzero status.

Real raw join matches 2,615/2,615 annotated barcodes exactly once across 84 matrices; all six timepoints are present in each of LD_1, LD_2, DD_1, and DD_2; 5,445 raw columns remain outside the supplied high-confidence annotation.
The raw feature list represents 14 of 15 candidates; para is labelled unevaluable in this matrix, not absent.
The published supplement scan covers 2,243 LD and 1,359 DD rows and extracts 21 candidate cluster-condition rows for nine candidates.
The public-data manifest validates without issues, and isolated replay returns verified_public_dataset_replay with all seven declared output hashes matching.
result_summary: Shab raw UMI was detected in s-LNv in 160/181 annotated LD cells and 97/142 annotated DD cells, matching the independent read-only forward audit. The published supplement lists Shab as a high-confidence cycler in s-LNv under both LD and DD. These findings prioritize follow-up only; they are not biological-replicate-level tests or evidence of channel function.
limitations: Cells are nested observations, not independent flies; no cell-level inferential comparison or rhythm model was fit.
Single-cell zero counts are vulnerable to dropout.
The extraction only transcribes the author-reported high-confidence cycling list, not all tested expression values.
The author rhythm method's cell-level JTK replication/pseudo-replication is retained as a methodological caution.
No protein, localization, electrophysiological current, membrane-potential, or causal behavior evidence is measured.
